name: Arimura Tadao
source:
His second wife gave him his one and only beloved daughter Mayu. Recently divorced he moves into the Family Planning apartments with Mayu unaware that being divorced disqualifies him from living there.

If the robot discovers his secret, he'll be thrown out into the streets . . .
